title: Semiconductor stocks pare losses amid fears of increased competition from China
excerpt: Worries over increased competition from China sent semiconductor stocks lower on Monday.
content_html:
What happened: Semiconductor stocks trimmed losses on Monday, with the PHLX Semiconductor Index (SOXX) recovering from a more than 2% drop as the sector shrugged off fears of increased competition from China and the overall market surged.

US-listed shares of memory and storage leaders Micron Technology (MU) and SK Hynix (SKHY) tumbled less than 1% and 2%, respectively.

AI chip heavyweight Nvidia (NVDA) gained 3% after dropping as much as 1%. Shares of AMD (AMD) also reversed an early morning loss to gain more than 1% ahead of the company's earnings this week. Chipmaker Intel (INTC), along with Marvell (MRVL) and Qualcomm (QCOM), also edged higher.

What's behind the move: The initial move in semiconductors came after China's Alibaba (BABA) unveiled its most powerful AI model yet, Qwen3.8-Max.

Meanwhile, a research firm noted that China-based AI developer DeepSeek's latest model is more than 100 times cheaper than Anthropic's (ANTH.PVT) Claude Fable 5.

The developments highlight intense competition among Chinese tech firms to develop advanced AI systems that are both powerful and affordable.

What else you need to know: Chinese AI companies are betting that open-weight AI models will give developers greater access and flexibility compared with the closed-source approach used by OpenAI, Anthropic, and Alphabet's (GOOG, GOOGL) Google.

The debate has been the focus of Silicon Valley in recent weeks.

Semiconductor stocks have been at the center of the AI trade this year, helping propel the sector to a record high in June.

Since then, chip stocks have tumbled into bear-market territory, falling more than 20% from their highs as investors grow increasingly concerned about hyperscalers' massive AI spending spree.

Worries about China's advancement in AI, driven by less expensive models, have also weighed on the AI infrastructure trade.

Ines Ferre is a senior business reporter for Yahoo Finance. Follow her on X at @ines_ferre.

content_html_zh:
发生了什么：半导体股票周一收复跌幅，PHLX 半导体指数 (SOXX) 从超过 2% 的跌幅中恢复过来，因为该行业摆脱了对中国竞争加剧的担忧，整体市场飙升。

美国上市的内存和存储领导者美光科技 (MU) 和 SK 海力士 (SKHY) 股价分别下跌不到 1% 和 2%。

AI芯片巨头英伟达(NVDA)在下跌1%后上涨3%。 AMD (AMD) 的股价也扭转了早盘的跌幅，在该公司本周公布财报之前上涨了 1% 以上。 芯片制造商英特尔 (INTC)、Marvell (MRVL) 和高通 (QCOM) 也小幅走高。

此举背后的原因：半导体领域的最初举措是在中国阿里巴巴（BABA）推出其迄今为止最强大的人工智能模型Qwen3.8-Max之后发生的。

与此同时，一家研究公司指出，中国人工智能开发商 DeepSeek 的最新模型比 Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) 的 Claude Fable 5 便宜 100 多倍。

这些事态发展突显了中国科技公司之间为开发功能强大且价格实惠的先进人工智能系统而展开的激烈竞争。

您还需要了解什么：中国人工智能公司认为，与 OpenAI、Anthropic 和 Alphabet（GOOG、GOOGL）谷歌使用的闭源方法相比，开放权重人工智能模型将为开发人员提供更大的访问权限和灵活性。

最近几周，这场争论一直是硅谷的焦点。

半导体股票一直是今年人工智能交易的中心，帮助推动该行业在 6 月份创下历史新高。

此后，随着投资者越来越担心超大规模企业的大规模人工智能支出热潮，芯片股跌入熊市，从高点下跌了 20% 以上。

人们对中国在更便宜的模型的推动下在人工智能领域取得进步的担忧也给人工智能基础设施贸易带来了压力。
